top_signals.title: China’s Mbappé Blackout Continues as Real Madrid Games Dropped
top_signals.summary: Football star Kylian Mbappé’s match for Real Madrid this weekend was unavailable on both television and digital streaming platforms in China, a sign that the backlash against the French athlete over a perceived insult to Mao Zedong has yet to fully subside.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
